articles.title: The race for 2028 has already begun | BBC Americast
articles.titleZh: 2028年的竞赛已经开始| BBC Americast
articles.summary:
Jim Messina, Democrat strategist and Obama’s former campaign manager gives us the inside track on what Democrats will look for in their next presidential candidate for 2028, and how the race has already started. 

Jim Messina and Justin discuss the priorities for a future candidate and why money (and the ability to raise millions) is essential. 

We also unpack the results and look at how the Democrats achieved huge midterm gains, and what their priorities should be for Congress.

00:00 The Blue Wave
00:40 Watching the votes come in
02:32 Dems' historic voteshare
07:35 Staying on message
13:30 Can Dems hold on to their gains?
17:40 How will Trump react? 
22:30 The 2028 race

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: At the scene of the shooting in Krakow | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 克拉科夫枪击事件现场| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
At least five people have been killed and about a dozen injured in a shooting in Krakow's Main Market Square, local police have said.
 
Details of the number of victims and injuries are still being established, the official account for the city of Krakow said.
 
The department said at around 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) a man drove into the square and began shooting "at random" from his car.

articles.title: Russian strikes in Ukraine leave nine injured and damage power network | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 俄罗斯在乌克兰的空袭造成9人受伤并损坏电网| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Overnight drone and ballistic missile attacks damaged Ukrainian energy infrastructure, President Volodymyr Zelenskyhas said, causing blackouts and disrupting water supplies.
 
Zelensky said 12 Ukrainian regions came under attack with the capital Kyiv hit hardest.
 
Nine people are reported to have been hurt across the country, including one child, in the wave of attacks that consisted of more than 30 ballistic missiles and over 170 drones.
 
The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Ukraine #Russia #BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
总统沃洛季米尔·泽连斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）表示，夜间无人机和弹道导弹袭击破坏了乌克兰的能源基础设施，导致停电和供水中断。

泽伦斯基说， 12个乌克兰地区受到攻击，首都基辅受到的打击最大。

据报道，在由30多枚弹道导弹和170多架无人机组成的袭击浪潮中，全国有9人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。

袭击发生后，乌克兰和俄罗斯代表团将于下周在阿布扎比参加三方会谈。
